lines: Running is good for you and good for our planet, too.
It is a good way to take care of your body and also a great way to get around without causing air pollution.
But did you know that running shoes can harm the environment?
That is because producing shoes releases a large amount of carbon.
Researchers studied the journey of one pair of shoes from beginning to end.
They found that a pair of running shoes produces about 30 pounds of carbon.
That is the same amount as leaving one 100-watt light bulb on for a whole week!
In 2010, about 25 billion pairs of shoes were sold around the world.
That means 750 billion pounds of carbon was released that year.
